title: The ring map of a morphism on affine opens induces the morphism on their spectra
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $U\subseteq X$ and $V\subseteq S$ be affine opens with $f(U)\subseteq V$, $A=\mathcal O_X(U)$, $R=\mathcal O_S(V)$. Let $\varphi:R\to A$ be the ring map induced by $f$, i.e. the composite of $f^\sharp_V:\mathcal O_S(V)\to\mathcal O_X(f^{-1}(V))$ with the restriction map $\mathcal O_X(f^{-1}(V))\to\mathcal O_X(U)$ (defined since $U\subseteq f^{-1}(V)$), and let $\iota_U:\operatorname{Spec}A\to X$ and $\iota_V:\operatorname{Spec}R\to S$ be the canonical open immersions with images $U$ and $V$ of [lem-weil-pbc-affine-open-spec-points]. Then $\iota_V\circ\operatorname{Spec}\varphi=f\circ\iota_U$ as morphisms $\operatorname{Spec}A\to S$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum].
